item.text: {"verdict":"request_changes","findings":[{"file":"internal/engine/prephase_repository.go","line":18,"priority":1,"description":"Rollback records only whether each repository artifact existed; it does not preserve the original contents of a pre-existing artifact. A valid crash-recovery state can contain repository.json.pending without repository.git. configureManagedRepositoryLocked then falls through and overwrites that pending manifest (even for a different request digest), while the failure callback treats it as pre-existing and leaves the replacement in place after a later SQL failure. Thus a rejected operation can destroy retained crash-recovery evidence and violates the stated pre-existing-artifact preservation guarantee. Reject incompatible/incomplete retained state or snapshot and restore any pre-existing file that may be rewritten; add a post-snapshot SQL-failure regression starting with pending-only state and asserting byte-for-byte preservation."}],"limitations":["Per request, no tools were used and supplied evidence was not independently reproduced.","Compatibility with the three explicitly excluded dirty source files was not assessed."]}
